_comment: Ocelot Eureka Configuration - Uses ServiceName for dynamic service discovery
_usage: This config is loaded when UseEureka=true. Gateway queries Eureka for service instances.
_benefit: Automatic load balancing, failover, and no manual host configuration needed
_caseNote: ServiceName must match Eureka registration. Eureka normalizes all names to UPPERCASE internally.

Routes._comment: Route: All auth operations - Login, validate, user lookup
Routes._discovery: ServiceName AUTH-SERVICE resolves to all registered instances via Eureka

Routes._comment: Route: All leave operations - Apply, approve, reject, cancel, history
Routes._discovery: ServiceName LEAVE-SERVICE resolves to all registered instances via Eureka

Routes._comment: Route: All notification operations with path parameters
Routes._discovery: ServiceName NOTIFICATION-SERVICE resolves to all registered instances via Eureka

Routes._comment: Route: GET all notifications (no path parameters)

GlobalConfiguration._comment: Global settings applied to all routes

ServiceDiscoveryProvider._comment: Tells Ocelot to use Eureka for service discovery instead of static hosts
ServiceDiscoveryProvider._requirement: Eureka server must be running and AddEureka() must be called in Program.cs
